entropy_ball_pit.name: Min-entropy: one guess
entropy_ball_pit.description: Min-entropy: four physical pyramids of sixteen full-size chairs (9 + 4 + 2 + 1). Grab, stack, release or walk into them; gravity and contacts determine what falls. Groups compare 8/8, 8/4/4 types, 12/4 and all pink. Group letters and IDs stay with the chairs. Uniform ID draws with replacement use private seed 435; spatial rearrangement does not alter the category probabilities. CHANGE ONE changes a type and RESET rebuilds a pyramid.

interactions: Grip and release a chair in VR; desktop right-click carries/drops and wheel changes distance. Walking nudges the physical stack.

entropy_jar_states.name: Four columns: different beginnings, continuing mixing
entropy_jar_states.description: Four broad glass jars on a shared limestone-coloured plinth: 1.04 m diameter and 2.30 m glass height, rounded shoulders, clear outward-facing skins and ceramic lids. Forty lavender and forty coral beads per jar retain the slow seed-435 paths. Eight-second inspection hold, live height/core-rim readings, PAUSE and RESTART on a side panel.
interactions: Approach and watch all four starting arrangements mix.
PAUSE / RESUME freezes or continues the current comparison.
RESTART restores the starting records and seeded motion.
